description: VisualDSL is an AI-powered Power BI visual: chat with your data in plain language and watch a custom visualization get generated on the fly, right inside your report. Key features: - Conversational interface — describe the chart or view you want, VisualDSL builds it live - Works with your existing report data via the Fields data role - Configurable AI provider and model in the formatting pane, plus a set of report-author-defined variables the chat can reference - No pre-built chart templates required — every visualization is generated per request Requirements: - An API key from a supported AI provider. Chat generation currently requires OpenRouter; other providers can be selected in the model picker but do not yet power live chat. - The API key is entered in the formatting pane and stored as a Power BI report property; treat it like any other credential in a shared report. Support: contact@mormitech.com
